The tallest is Kaleb Tarczewski at 213 cm. The youngest is Leonardo Faggian (born 2004) and the most experienced John Petrucelli (born 1992). Beyond Italy, the squad draws most on USA (5), Australia (1) and North Macedonia (1). Guglielmo Caruso, Leonardo Tote and Markel Brown are back for another spell at the club.
